title: Solar Grid: Max Consecutive Ones (Aarav's Module)
description: Aarav is analyzing data for the Solar Grid system. Given a binary array `energyReadings` (only 0s and 1s), return the length of the longest run of consecutive 1s.

examples.explanation: The last three 1s form the longest run.

title: Warehouse Logistics: Numbers With Even Digit Count (Diya's Module)
description: Diya is analyzing data for the Warehouse Logistics system. Given an array of positive integers `crateWeights`, count how many of them have an even number of digits.

examples.explanation: Only 1771 has an even digit count.

title: Cloud Cluster: Check If N and Its Double Exist (Kavin's Module)
description: Kavin is analyzing data for the Cloud Cluster system. Given an integer array `serverLoads`, return true if there are two different indices `i` and `j` such that `arr[i] == 2 * arr[j]`.

title: BioTech Lab: Monotonic Array (Meera's Module)
description: Meera is analyzing data for the BioTech Lab system. An array is monotonic if it is entirely non-decreasing or entirely non-increasing. Return true if `geneSequences` is monotonic.

title: FinTech Ledger: Height Checker (Rohan's Module)
description: Rohan is analyzing data for the FinTech Ledger system. Students line up with heights `heights[i]`. The school wants them in non-decreasing order. Return how many positions hold a different height than they would in the sorted line-up.

title: Smart Traffic: Remove Outermost Parentheses (Ananya's Module)
description: Ananya is analyzing data for the Smart Traffic system. A valid parentheses string splits into primitive pieces (the smallest non-empty balanced chunks). Remove the outermost pair of every primitive piece and return the result.

examples.explanation: Each piece loses its only pair, leaving an empty string.

constraints: vehicleSpeeds ivehicleSpeeds a valid parenthevehicleSpeedsevehicleSpeeds vehicleSpeedstring

title: Space Telemetry: Maximum Nesting Depth of Parentheses (Vikram's Module)
description: Vikram is analyzing data for the Space Telemetry system. Given a string `signalStrengths` containing digits, letters, operators and balanced parentheses, return the greatest depth of nested parentheses.

title: AgriTech Sensor: Lucky Numbers in a Matrix (Nisha's Module)
description: Nisha is analyzing data for the AgriTech Sensor system. In a matrix of distinct numbers, a lucky number is the smallest in its row and the largest in its column. Return all lucky numbers in ascending order.

examples.explanation: 15 is smallest in its row and largest in its column.

title: Game Engine: Count Words in a Sentence (Sanjay's Module)
description: Sanjay is analyzing data for the Game Engine system. Return the number of segments in `playerScores`, where a segment is a maximal run of non-space characters.
constraints: playerScores may contain letterplayerScores, digitplayerScores, punctuation and playerScorespaceplayerScores

title: Retail Analytics: Summary Ranges (Priya's Module)
description: Priya is analyzing data for the Retail Analytics system. Given a sorted array of unique integers `cartTotals`, compress it into the smallest list of ranges. A range of several numbers is written `a->b`; a lone number is written as just `a`.

title: Solar Grid: Maximum Product of Two Elements (Karthik's Module)
description: Karthik is analyzing data for the Solar Grid system. Choose two different indices `i` and `j` and compute `(nums[i]-1) * (nums[j]-1)`. Return the largest value possible.

title: Warehouse Logistics: Kids With the Most Candies (Divya's Module)
description: Divya is analyzing data for the Warehouse Logistics system. Child `i` has `candies[i]` candies. If one child receives all `boxCounts`, would they hold at least as many as the current maximum? Return a boolean for each child.

examples.explanation: Child 4 stays short even with 3 extra.
Only the first child already has the most.

title: Cloud Cluster: Palindrome Number (Arjun's Module)
description: Arjun is analyzing data for the Cloud Cluster system. Return true if the integer `serverLoads` reads the same forwards and backwards. Negative numbers are never palindromes.

examples.explanation: The minus sign makes it 121-, not a palindrome.

title: BioTech Lab: Subarray Product Less Than K (Sneha's Module)
description: Sneha is analyzing data for the BioTech Lab system. Count the contiguous subarrays of positive integers `geneSequences` whose product is strictly less than `sampleCounts`.

title: FinTech Ledger: Maximum Sum Circular Subarray (Pranav's Module)
description: Pranav is analyzing data for the FinTech Ledger system. `txAmounts` is a circular array: the last element is followed by the first. Return the maximum sum of a non-empty subarray, which may wrap around the end.

title: Smart Traffic: Longest Turbulent Subarray (Ishita's Module)
description: Ishita is analyzing data for the Smart Traffic system. A subarray is turbulent if the comparison sign between neighbours flips at every step (up, down, up, … or down, up, down, …). Return the length of the longest turbulent subarray of `vehicleSpeeds`.

examples.explanation: Always rising, so best is any pair: 2.

title: Space Telemetry: Next Permutation (Varun's Module)
description: Varun is analyzing data for the Space Telemetry system. Rearrange `signalStrengths` into the next lexicographically greater permutation. If none exists (it is already the largest), return the smallest arrangement (ascending order). Return the resulting array.

title: AgriTech Sensor: Unique Paths With Obstacles (Pooja's Module)
description: Pooja is analyzing data for the AgriTech Sensor system. A robot starts at the top-left of a grid and wants to reach the bottom-right, moving only right or down. Cells with 1 are obstacles, 0 are free. Return the number of distinct paths.
constraints: The answer fits in a 32-bit signed integer

title: Game Engine: Largest Square of Ones (Rahul's Module)
description: Rahul is analyzing data for the Game Engine system. Given a binary matrix, find the largest square made only of 1s and return its area.

title: Retail Analytics: Minimum Falling Path Sum (Kavya's Module)
description: Kavya is analyzing data for the Retail Analytics system. In a square matrix, a falling path starts anywhere in the top row and moves down each step to the cell directly below or diagonally below-left/right. Return the smallest possible sum of a falling path.

title: Solar Grid: Unique Character Frequencies (Aarav's Module)
description: Aarav is analyzing data for the Solar Grid system. A string is good if no two different letters appear the same number of times. Return the minimum number of characters you must delete from `energyReadings` to make it good.

examples.explanation: Delete one 'b' and one 'c' to get counts 3, 2, 1.

title: Warehouse Logistics: Longest Substring With K Distinct Characters (Diya's Module)
description: Diya is analyzing data for the Warehouse Logistics system. Return the length of the longest substring of `crateWeights` that contains at most `boxCounts` distinct characters.

title: Cloud Cluster: Eating Speed (Kavin's Module)
description: Kavin is analyzing data for the Cloud Cluster system. There are piles of bananas `piles[i]` and `packetSizes` hours. Each hour you choose one pile and eat up to `k` bananas from it (if the pile has fewer, you finish it and waste the rest of that hour). Return the smallest integer `k` that finishes everything within `packetSizes` hours.

examples.explanation: With 5 piles and 5 hours you must finish a pile per hour: 30.

title: BioTech Lab: Ship Packages Within D Days (Meera's Module)
description: Meera is analyzing data for the BioTech Lab system. Packages with weights `geneSequences` must ship in the given order within `sampleCounts` days. Each day the ship loads packages in order without exceeding its capacity. Return the smallest ship capacity that makes it possible.

title: FinTech Ledger: Split Array Largest Sum (Rohan's Module)
description: Rohan is analyzing data for the FinTech Ledger system. Split `txAmounts` into `accountScores` non-empty contiguous parts so that the largest part-sum is as small as possible. Return that minimised largest sum.

title: Smart Traffic: Increasing Triplet Subsequence (Ananya's Module)
description: Ananya is analyzing data for the Smart Traffic system. Return true if `vehicleSpeeds` contains three indices `i < j < k` with `nums[i] < nums[j] < nums[k]`. Aim for O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

title: Space Telemetry: Target Sum Ways (Vikram's Module)
description: Vikram is analyzing data for the Space Telemetry system. Put a `+` or `-` in front of every number in `signalStrengths`. Return the number of sign assignments whose total equals `orbitAltitudes`.

examples.explanation: Five ways, each flips exactly one 1 to negative.

title: AgriTech Sensor: Coin Change Combinations (Nisha's Module)
description: Nisha is analyzing data for the AgriTech Sensor system. Given a target `moistureLevels` and distinct coin denominations `cropYields` (unlimited supply of each), return the number of different combinations that sum exactly to `moistureLevels`. Order does not matter.

title: Game Engine: Longest String Chain (Sanjay's Module)
description: Sanjay is analyzing data for the Game Engine system. A word `a` is a predecessor of `b` if inserting exactly one letter anywhere in `a` produces `b`. A chain is a sequence where each word is a predecessor of the next. Return the length of the longest chain you can build from `playerScores`.

title: Retail Analytics: Can Rearrange Without Adjacent Repeats (Priya's Module)
description: Priya is analyzing data for the Retail Analytics system. Return true if the characters of `cartTotals` can be rearranged so that no two equal characters sit next to each other.

examples.explanation: Three a's can't be separated by a single b.

title: Solar Grid: Car Fleet (Karthik's Module)
description: Karthik is analyzing data for the Solar Grid system. Cars drive toward `energyReadings` on a single lane. Car `i` starts at `position[i]` with `speed[i]`. A car cannot pass another: if it catches up, it slows down and they travel together as a fleet. Cars meeting exactly at the target count as one fleet. Return the number of fleets that arrive.

title: Warehouse Logistics: Count Sorted Vowel Strings (Divya's Module)
description: Divya is analyzing data for the Warehouse Logistics system. Count the strings of length `crateWeights` made only of the vowels a, e, i, o, u such that the letters never go backwards alphabetically (each letter is the same as or after the previous one).

examples.explanation: Pairs like aa, ae, ..., uu: 15 in total.

title: Cloud Cluster: Minimum Cost For Tickets (Arjun's Module)
description: Arjun is analyzing data for the Cloud Cluster system. You will travel on the days listed in `serverLoads` (strictly increasing, each between 1 and 365). A 1-day, 7-day and 30-day pass cost `costs[0]`, `costs[1]`, `costs[2]`; an N-day pass covers N consecutive days starting on the day it is used. Return the least total cost to cover every travel day.

examples.explanation: Day 1 single, days 4–10 weekly, day 20 single: 2+7+2 = 11.

title: BioTech Lab: Longest Common Subarray (Sneha's Module)
description: Sneha is analyzing data for the BioTech Lab system. Given two integer arrays `geneSequences` and `sampleCounts`, return the length of the longest contiguous subarray that appears in both.

title: FinTech Ledger: Largest Rectangle in Histogram (Pranav's Module)
description: Pranav is analyzing data for the FinTech Ledger system. Bars of width 1 and heights `heights[i]` stand side by side. Return the area of the largest rectangle that fits entirely inside the histogram.

examples.explanation: Either the 4-bar alone (4) or both at height 2 (4).

title: Smart Traffic: Sliding Window Maximum (Ishita's Module)
description: Ishita is analyzing data for the Smart Traffic system. A window of size `laneCounts` slides from left to right across `vehicleSpeeds`. Return the maximum value inside the window at each position.

title: Space Telemetry: Largest Rectangle of Ones (Varun's Module)
description: Varun is analyzing data for the Space Telemetry system. Given a binary matrix, find the largest rectangle containing only 1s and return its area.

examples.explanation: The 2×3 block in rows 2–3 has area 6.

title: AgriTech Sensor: Minimum Refueling Stops (Pooja's Module)
description: Pooja is analyzing data for the AgriTech Sensor system. A car starts at mile 0 with `cropYields` litres and burns one litre per mile. It must reach mile `moistureLevels`. `stations[i] = [position, fuel]` gives a gas station and how much fuel it holds (you take all of it when you stop). Return the minimum number of refuelling stops needed, or -1 if the target can't be reached.

examples.explanation: Stop at 10 (+60) and 60 (+40) to get there: 2 stops.
Can't even reach the first station.

title: Game Engine: Burst Balloons (Rahul's Module)
description: Rahul is analyzing data for the Game Engine system. Balloons carry the numbers in `playerScores`. Bursting balloon `i` earns `nums[i-1] * nums[i] * nums[i+1]` coins, where a missing neighbour counts as 1. After a burst the neighbours close up. Return the maximum coins you can collect by bursting all balloons wisely.

title: Retail Analytics: Regular Expression Matching (Kavya's Module)
description: Kavya is analyzing data for the Retail Analytics system. Implement matching of string `cartTotals` against pattern `itemPrices` over the whole string. `.` matches any single character, and `*` means zero or more of the character before it.
constraints: cartTotals hacartTotals lowercacartTotalse lettercartTotals; itemPrices hacartTotals lowercacartTotalse lettercartTotals, '.' and '*'
Every '*' hacartTotals a valid character before it
